name: io.github.iowarp/slurm-mcp
title: CLIO Slurm
description: MCP server for Slurm workload management and HPC job scheduling

tools.name: submit_slurm_job
tools.description: Submit a job script to the Slurm scheduler with resource requirements.

tools.name: check_job_status
tools.description: Check the status of a Slurm job by its ID.

tools.name: cancel_slurm_job
tools.description: Cancel a running or pending Slurm job.

tools.name: list_slurm_jobs
tools.description: List Slurm jobs with optional filtering by user and state.

tools.name: get_slurm_info
tools.description: Get Slurm cluster configuration, partitions, and resource availability.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Slurm job.

tools.name: get_job_output
tools.description: Retrieve stdout or stderr output from a Slurm job.

tools.name: get_queue_info
tools.description: Get Slurm queue status and partition information.

tools.name: submit_array_job
tools.description: Submit a Slurm array job for parallel task execution.

tools.name: get_node_info
tools.description: Get information about Slurm cluster nodes and their resources.

tools.name: allocate_slurm_nodes
tools.description: Allocate Slurm nodes for an interactive session using salloc.

tools.name: deallocate_slurm_nodes
tools.description: Release a Slurm node allocation by canceling it.

tools.name: get_allocation_status
tools.description: Check the status of a Slurm node allocation.

prompts.name: submit_job_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for submitting and monitoring a Slurm job.
